verdict.rationale: Internal comment threads with @mentions beside an email are a fair question for an email product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no such feature. Delegation lets someone act on an account, not discuss a message, and Workspace add-ons are developer building blocks, not a shipped side-thread capability.

support.subject: As a team-lead, we can discuss an email in an internal side-thread — comments and @mentions beside the message — instead of forwarding copies around
